limitations: Not real users, demand, traffic, revenue, willingness-to-pay, or source truth.
This packet is directional usability evidence only and does not establish a market, product outcome, or source-backed current event.

personas.task: Determine whether a current Google incident explained volatility.
personas.outcome: Unable to decide whether a current Google incident explained volatility.
Unable to search, filter, or subscribe.

p0Findings: All public records are controlled fixtures.
There is no search input, filtering, status/date/service navigation, alert or digest CTA, offer, analytics, or conversion event.

experiments.hypothesis: A source-bound retrieval surface may help visitors inspect records without converting records into causal claims about their own sites.
experiments.firstUserOutcome: Enter a query/filter over source-bound records with explicit empty and error states.
experiments.metric: Unmeasured filter-to-record completion after 10 observed non-synthetic sessions.
experiments.stopRule: <30% after 10 sessions retires or reframes the experiment.
experiments.noDataBoundary: No data means no demand or revenue conclusion.
experiments.blockedBy: Coordinator-owned shared renderer/static-build/CSP adapter; public functional surface is not shipped.
experiments.nextSafeAction: Keep the experiment specification and regression gate current; await coordinator-owned adapter authority before implementing a public surface.

experiments.hypothesis: Clearly distinguishing controlled examples from current incident evidence before a visitor considers investigating their own site may prevent unsupported causal interpretation.
experiments.firstUserOutcome: Recognize that controlled examples are not current incident evidence before considering an investigation of their own site.
experiments.metric: Unmeasured currentness-disclosure comprehension after 10 observed non-synthetic sessions.
experiments.stopRule: <30% after 10 sessions retires or reframes the experiment.
experiments.noDataBoundary: No data means no demand or revenue conclusion.
experiments.nextSafeAction: Use the public disclosure to distinguish controlled examples from current incident evidence; do not infer demand or revenue without measured non-synthetic sessions.
